cloud.login.title: Log in to Forge cloud
cloud.login.summary: Standard Worker entry points refuse cloud requests until v3 launches. Existing rehearsal and custom deployments fall outside Forge 0.0.1 support. Log in to a compatible deployment with the owner's approval, save the credential privately and bind the project. Never prints the token.

cloud.logout.title: Log out of Forge cloud
cloud.logout.summary: Unbind this checkout from its Forge cloud project: removes this project's saved credential, then .forge/cloud.json, so the checkout uses the local store again. Other projects' credentials are kept. The device token is not revoked on the server. Never prints the token.
